Coram : INDIRA BANERJEE*, KRISHNA MURARI
Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996: ss. 36 and 9 – Arbitration award – Interference with – On facts, award of Rs 142 cr in favour of the respondent – Challenge to, by the appellant before the High Court u/s. 34 – Same day the appellant filed interim application the arbitral award – Subsequently, the respondent filed an application u/s. 9 seeking orders on the appellant to furnish security against the amount awarded – Thereafter, appellant directed to deposit 10% of the amounts in its bank accounts, at interval of every 15 days –
Decision Date : 19-09-2022 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6789/2022 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
